selection: the 15 s wall-clock span, slid at one-second steps over the ten archives' union, maximizing first the count of games live for every second of it and then the total live seconds across all games; a second is live when the game clock strictly decreases across adjacent moments no more than 1000 ms apart
fold: each game's positions fold to one halfcourt through the corpus's own frame (window.py:to_shot_frame), toward the hoop nearer the ball's median position over the span - fixed per game, so a body crossing midcourt stays one continuous path off the plate's edge rather than reflecting at the line
treatment: cut at every step over paint.py:MAX_STEP_FT and every feed gap over the game's own modal spacing times window.py:FRAME_GAP_FACTOR; runs under paint.py:MIN_RUN_FRAMES dropped; Douglas-Peucker at paint.py:SIMPLIFY_FT with zone crossings forced, exactly as the paint
identity: none: nothing names a body, a game, an event or a clock. A path carries a start offset inside the one anonymous span, because simultaneity is the subject; the pinned index layout is the gate that keeps everything else out

slate_strokes.fields: x, y (int16 tenths, hoop at origin); dt (uint16 frames); arc (uint16 tenths)

slate_index.fields: first vertex (uint32); count (uint16); start (uint16 frames from the span's open); kind (uint8, 1 = ball)
